rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA)
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The adjustment is calculated as 65% of the Consumer Price Index increase for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148; Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board Public Notice dated October 17, 2025
rules.quoted_span:
the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent stabilization covered unit in Berkeley, CA with tenancy commencement before January 1, 2025
rules.exemptions: Tenancies commenced on or after January 1, 2025; units subject to Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

field_evidence.quoted_span:
allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026

The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer 
Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 
2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5%

The 
65% of CPI formula was approved by Berkeley voters in the November 2004 general 
municipal election
